_comment: Single source for team details and the division of labour. Each member owns the same stage across code, dashboard page, report sections, slides and agent trajectory. Update the GitHub URL, then rebuild the report (uv run hashatlas report) and slides (cd presentation/build && ./make.sh).
course: CDS3004 Data Mining, Lingnan University, 2026/27 Term 1

members.name: LO Chi Kong
members.role: Captain: problem definition, data engineering, integration and delivery
contributions: Defined the miner-decision problem, users, constraints and alternative solutions
Built acquisition of 6,500+ daily block dumps, pool definitions, solo lists, network charts and electricity prices with SHA-256 provenance
Cleaned and labelled 975k blocks; wrote the data dictionary, quality checks and label audit
Integrated the pipeline (configuration, CLI, run-all), the report build, the dashboard shell and theme, deployment and the introduction video; compiled the final report and submission
members.code: src/hashatlas/config.py, cli.py, acquire.py, clean.py, report.py; configs/; web/src/App.tsx, styles.css, pages/Overview.tsx, pages/Methods.tsx; presentation/video/
members.dashboard: Overview, Methods & Data, site shell and deployment
members.slides: Title, introduction video, questions, problem, data, conclusion

members.name: POON Tsz Chun
members.role: Feature transformation, feature selection and model learning
contributions: Designed the fingerprint features (version/nonce bit decomposition, body ratios, day-relative policy) and the leakage exclusions
Ran feature selection: variance filter, mutual information against noise probes, Spearman redundancy and group ablation
Tuned the decision tree, KNN and linear/RBF SVM with month-grouped and nested cross-validation; froze the model choice before testing

members.name: SUBEDI Anukaran
members.role: Performance evaluation, model explanation and decisions on new blocks
contributions: Evaluated the frozen models on the sealed 2025-26 test period: macro-F1, confusion, ROC/PR, day-block bootstrap and drift
Explained the tree (worked Gini split, permutation importance) and mapped newcomer pools to their nearest template
Applied the frozen model to unattributed blocks and to blocks mined after the data freeze; produced the report figures
members.slides: Sealed-test results, confusion and newcomers, blocks after the freeze

members.name: YE Xiaochen
members.role: Clustering, association rules and independent verification
contributions: Rediscovered the mining eras with K-means, four hierarchical linkages and DBSCAN; built pool families by dendrogram
Implemented Apriori from scratch with brute-force verification, rule confirmation on a later window and the solo contrast
Wrote the independent verification checks and the unit-test suite; led the interpretation and limitations review
members.code: src/hashatlas/clusters.py, rules.py, verify.py; tests/; web/src/pages/Eras.tsx, Rules.tsx
members.slides: Mining eras, pool families and rules, limits and verification
